qs.q: Which muscle acts to pull the patella medially, thereby helping to resist natural lateral patellar dislocation?
qs.e: The oblique fibres of the vastus medialis pull the patella medially to counteract the lateral pull of the quadriceps mechanism. Other stabilizing factors include the medial patellofemoral ligament and the deep trochlear groove.
